label: Formulated and introduced The Veil of Ignorance & Difference Principle
description: John Rawls formulated and introduced the concept of "The Veil of Ignorance & Difference Principle", which became a seminal contribution in political philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in political.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Contemporary & Post-Structural as part of John Rawls's canonical writings.
